The overview

Marrakech is Morocco's 'Red City' — a sensory swirl of souks, palaces and gardens behind ochre walls, with the Atlas Mountains on the horizon.

📍 Top things to do in Marrakech

  • Get lost in the medina souks
  • Experience Jemaa el-Fnaa square at night
  • Visit the Bahia Palace and Saadian Tombs
  • Relax in the Jardin Majorelle
  • Day-trip to the Atlas Mountains

📅 Best time to visit

The sweet spot for Marrakech is generally year-round — and the cheapest fares often land just outside peak season.

🛡 Is it safe?

Check your government's latest travel advisory. Watch your belongings in crowds and tourist areas, and check your government’s current advisory before you go. Visa for US passports: Check entry requirements for US passports.

📜 A bit of history

Founded in 1070 as an imperial capital, Marrakech was a center of trade and learning on caravan routes across the Sahara.

🌍 Culture & language

Moroccan culture is Arab-Berber and deeply hospitable — mint tea rituals, tagines, intricate craft, and lively bargaining in the souks.

Language: the local language · English spoken: varies
